entries.title: Ezekiel 20:1
segments: And it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], the tenth of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to ask of the LORD, and sat before me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:2
segments: And came the word of the LORD to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:3
segments: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Have you come to ask of Me? [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:4
segments: Will you judge [them], son of man, will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:5
segments: And say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I chose Israel, and lifted up My hand to the seed of the house of Jacob, and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt; when I lifted up My hand to them, saying, I [am] the LORD your God;

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:6
segments: in the day [that] I lifted up My hand to them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing [with] milk and honey, which [is] the glory of all lands;

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:7
segments: then I said to them, Let each man throw away the abominations of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:8
segments: But they rebelled against Me and would not listen to Me. They did not each man throw away the abominations of their eyes, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. And I said, I will pour out My fury against them to fulfill My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:9
segments: But I worked for My name's sake, that it should not be profaned before the nations among whom they [were, for] I made Myself known to them in their eyes, by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:10
segments: And I caused them to go out from the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:11
segments: And I gave them My statutes and showed them My judgments, which [if] a man do, he shall even live in them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:12
segments: And also I gave them My sabbaths to be a sign between Me and them, that [they] might know that I [am] the LORD who sets them apart.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:13
segments: But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness; they did not walk in My statutes, and they despised My judgments, which [if] a man does, he shall even live in them. And they greatly profaned My sabbaths. And I said, [ I] will pour out My fury on them in the wilderness to destroy them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:14
segments: But I worked for My name's sake, so that it should not be profaned before the nations in whose sight I brought them out.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:15
segments: And also I lifted up My hand to them in the wilderness, that [I] would not bring them into the land which I had given [them], flowing [with] milk and honey; it [is] the glory of all lands;

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:16
segments: because they despised My judgments and walked not in My sabbaths; and they profaned My sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:17
segments: But My eye spared them from destroying them, nor did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:18
segments: But I said to their sons in the wilderness, Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, nor observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:19
segments: I [am] the LORD your God. Walk in My statutes, and keep My judgments, and do them,

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:20
segments: and keep My sabbaths holy; and they shall be a sign between Me and you, that you may know that I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:21
segments: But the sons rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes, nor kept My judgments to do them; the judgments which, [if] a man do, he shall even live in them; they profaned My sabbaths and I said [I] would pour out My fury on them, to fulfill My anger against them in the wilderness.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:22
segments: But I withdrew My hand and worked for My name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations, from whom I brought them out in their eyes.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:23
segments: I also lifted up My hand to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and scatter them through the lands,

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:24
segments: because they had not done My judgments, but had despised My sabbaths and had profaned My sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:25
segments: Also I gave them statutes not good, and judgments by which they should not live.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:26
segments: And I defiled them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that open the womb to pass through [the fire], that I might waste them, to the end that they might know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:27
segments: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed Me, in that they have committed a sin against Me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:28
segments: When I had brought them into the land [for] which I lifted up My hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered their sacrifices there. And there they offered their provoking gifts. There also they made their sweet aroma, and poured out their drink offerings there.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:29
segments: And I said to them, What [is] the high place to which you go? And the name of it is called High Place to this day.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:30
segments: Therefore say to the house of Israel, So says the Lord Jehovah: Are you defiled in the same way as your fathers? And do you go whoring after their abominations?

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:31
segments: For when you offer your gifts, when you make your sons to pass through the fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols, even to [this] day. And shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? [As] I Live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:32
segments: And what comes up on your spirit shall not happen at all, that you say, We will be like the nations, like the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:33
segments: [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, I will reign over you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:34
segments: And I will bring you out from the people, and I will gather you out of the lands in which you are scattered among them, with a mighty hand and with a stretched out arm and with fury poured out.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:35
segments: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:36
segments: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, says the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:37
segments: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:38
segments: And I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who sin against Me. I will bring them out from the land where they reside, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:39
segments: And you, O house of Israel, so says the Lord Jehovah: [Every] man go and serve his idols, and do so from now on if you will not listen to Me. But never again defile My holy name with your gifts and with your idols.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:40
segments: For in My holy mountain, in the mountain height [of] Israel, says the Lord Jehovah, there all the house of Israel, all of those in the land, shall serve Me. There will I receive them, and there will I ask for your offerings and the firstfruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:41
segments: I will receive you with your sweet aroma when I bring you out from the people and gather you out of the lands into which you have been scattered among them. And I will be sanctified in you in the eyes of the nations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:42
segments: And you shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the land [for] which I lifted up My hand, to give it to your fathers.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:43
segments: And there you shall remember your ways and all your doings in which you have been defiled. And you shall despise yourselves in your own sight for all your evils which you have committed.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:44
segments: And you shall know that I [am] the LORD when I have worked with you for My name's sake, not according to your wicked ways nor according to your corrupt doings, O house of Israel, says the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:45
segments: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:46
segments: Son of man, set your face toward the south, and drop a [word] toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:47
segments: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD. So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it shall burn up every green tree in you, and every dry tree among you. The flaming flame shall not be put out, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned in it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:48
segments: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it. It shall not be put out.

entries.title: Ezekiel 20:49
segments: And I said, Ah Lord Jehovah! They say of me, Does he not speak parables?
